milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Cyan wool blocks are at (-4,1,1) to (-6,1,1) in the left corridor. Max_distance=4 ensures the player has actually entered the corridor — spawn distance to target (-5,1,1) is ~5.2 blocks which exceeds the threshold, preventing false triggering from the central hub.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Pink glazed terracotta is at (5,1,3) and (6,1,3) on the right corridor wall. Max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered the right corridor — spawn distance to target (5,1,3) is ~6.2 blocks which exceeds the threshold.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Magenta bed foot is at (-9,0,-3) in the bedroom wing. Max_distance=5 ensures the player has navigated past the cyan wool corridor to the bedroom doorway at (-7,0,-1) or entered the room — spawn distance to target is ~10 blocks which far exceeds the threshold.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Blue ice blocks are at (-8,0,4) to (-10,0,4) in the cold room. Max_distance=5 ensures the player has navigated to the cold room doorway at (-7,0,2) or entered the room — spawn distance to target is ~10.3 blocks which far exceeds the threshold.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The acacia fence gate is at (11,0,0) at the end of the right corridor. Max_distance=4 ensures the player has traversed the entire right corridor to its exit — spawn distance to target is 11 blocks which far exceeds the threshold.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Cows are summoned at (15,0,2) and (16,0,3) in the fenced pasture. Max_distance=6 ensures the player has passed through the fence gate and entered the pasture area — spawn distance to target (15,0,2) is ~15.1 blocks which far exceeds the threshold. The player can walk deeper into the pasture if cows have wandered.

Uses inventory_has because mining a smithing table drops the smithing_table item into the player's inventory. The smithing table at (16,0,-3) blocks the workshop's only doorway and can be mined with any tool or bare hands, always dropping itself. Player has a wooden_pickaxe. Item appearing in inventory confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because mining red nether brick stairs with a pickaxe drops the item into inventory. The stairs at (15,0,-5) and (16,0,-5) are inside the workshop, only accessible after mining the smithing table doorway blocker. Red nether brick stairs REQUIRE a pickaxe to drop — player has wooden_pickaxe which is sufficient (any tier works).

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden axe places it in the player's inventory. The player must enter the workshop (after mining smithing table), open the chest containing 3 oak logs + 2 sticks, craft logs into planks at the crafting table, then craft the wooden axe (3 planks + 2 sticks). Player does NOT start with wooden_axe (only wooden_pickaxe), so its presence confirms successful crafting.
